description: This file is a header file (.h) for logging functionality in the RBUS core module. It defines logging macros that wrap around functions provided by the 'rtLog' module, facilitating different levels of logging such as error, warning, info, debug, and trace, all tagged with 'RBUSCORE'. It also includes licensing information and include guards.

methods.name: RBUSCORELOG_ERROR
methods.description: Macro for logging error messages, wraps rtLog_ErrorPrint with 'RBUSCORE' tag.

methods.name: RBUSCORELOG_WARN
methods.description: Macro for logging warning messages, wraps rtLog_WarnPrint with 'RBUSCORE' tag.

methods.name: RBUSCORELOG_INFO
methods.description: Macro for logging informational messages, wraps rtLog_InfoPrint with 'RBUSCORE' tag.

methods.name: RBUSCORELOG_DEBUG
methods.description: Macro for logging debug messages, wraps rtLog_DebugPrint with 'RBUSCORE' tag.

methods.name: RBUSCORELOG_TRACE
methods.description: Macro for tracing debug messages, also wraps rtLog_DebugPrint with 'RBUSCORE' tag.
